name: docmd
description: docmd is a zero-config documentation generator that compiles a folder of Markdown files into a static documentation website.
notes: firstRelease from npm @docmd/core creation (2026-02-12). This setup pins @docmd/core 0.9.7 and disables every bundled plugin (search, seo, sitemap, analytics, llms, mermaid, git, openapi, okf, ai), the sidebar, header, breadcrumbs, page navigation and options menu; each post renders as its own page.
